title: Hidden turns
notes: On return, K-1 can change one counter (P3) or test five-/six-ring patterns and two different constructions (P4-6). Grades 2-3 can choose the six-ring proof (P4) or eight-ring minority minimum (P5). Grades 4-5 can connect the small-ring obstruction (P3) to a construction for every larger ring (P4-5). Save a candidate on tracing paper before changing it; the original stays fixed while the copy moves.
